# {{ site.name | default: site.title }}

{{ site.author.bio | default: site.description }}

I work in Oracle AI Foundations under the guidance of [Dan Roth](https://www.cis.upenn.edu/~danroth/) and [Sujith Ravi](https://blogs.oracle.com/authors/sujithravi/), advancing agentic and enterprise AI, multimodal models, and media understanding.

I build applied-science teams and lead research from problem selection and system architecture through evaluation and product integration. My applied-science contributions span Oracle Fusion ERP, Oracle AI Database 26ai and cloud support workflows.

Current work spans Shared Knowledge Store (SKS), a shared knowledge layer for enterprise AI; agentic information retrieval; cloud DevOps and support automation; multimodal and media search; model adaptation and evaluation. The leadership-coaching work described on the site is a pilot.

Research directions: agents that use knowledge, memory and tools; multimodal understanding across language, images and video; evaluation of reasoning, robustness and bias.
